# ADR-3010: A01: Prefer deny-by-default catalogs for capability set 10

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Allow-by-default catalogs accumulate unused rights.

## Decision

Platforms SHOULD prefer deny-by-default catalogs for capability set 10 (A01-10) where capability sprawl is a risk.

## Consequences

Periodic access reviews remain is expected to.
